title: 完整人工智能训练课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含由Fernando Amaral教授讲授的完整AI训练课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，配有Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for a complete AI training course covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, with Python hands-on practice, projects, and notebooks.
